scope: Candidate undeformed native-circle geometry/constraint compatibility and resident baseline comparison only; no mechanics

processing.region_tags_policy: unchanged physical coordinates, directions, components and averaging
processing.task_policy: No HF task, materials, applied constraints or mechanical qualification are created

keys.solid: bool ny x nx, 1 = mechanism solid

descriptor.geometry_id_rule: content hash of (case, native mesh, domain, thickness, solid, passive_solid, passive_void) with the v1 header: identical for the same geometry in v1 and v2

grid.analysis_rule: integer nested copy of native cells
grid.axes: +x right, +y up; array index [j, i] = [row from bottom, column from left]
grid.model_extent: lower half model; mirror plane y = 40 mm

native.model: measure_floor_free: Emin = 1e-12 * E_scale, floating nodes fixed, 2x2 Gauss, all elements assembled

analysis.constraints: case fixed dofs (support ux,uy; symmetry uy per policy) plus every dof of nodes not attached to a solid element

native.constraints: case fixed dofs (support ux,uy; symmetry uy per policy) plus every dof of nodes not attached to a solid element

task.input: force F = 1 N through the input port vector, k_in = 0
task.quantities: gain = q_out/q_in (independent of the input control in the linear regime); input stiffness = F/q_in
task.symmetry: regions_mm.symmetry_solid (+ symmetry_background for the gripper), uy = 0

regions_mm.interval_convention: closed segments include both end nodes; complement_on_line excludes start_exclusive_mm and includes end_inclusive_mm
regions_mm.output_meaning: q_out > 0 = lower jaw moves toward the mirror plane (closing)

support.attachment_semantics: the LF references constrain only segment nodes attached to a solid element; third-medium consumers must choose 'solid_incident' or 'all_segment_nodes' explicitly (not the same policy under another name)
support.semantics: physical clamp on x = 0; a consumer constrains the nodes on this segment

symmetry_background.semantics: complement of symmetry_solid on the mirror line: the physical open-closed interval (solid_end, domain_end]; derive the node set on the consumer grid (first node at solid_end + h; the end point itself belongs to the solid segment); LF policy full_midline, a modelling choice for the medium above the passive void, not a physical clamp

symmetry_solid.semantics: contract symmetry line of the half model (mirror plane)

source.note: generation conditions are metadata only; the HF task is defined by the consumer

processing.task_policy: Source boundary metadata is provenance; no HF task or applied constraints are created

hf_analysis_domain_derivations.index_policy: physical coordinates unchanged; row strides change; rebuild cell/node/DOF indices and direction
hf_analysis_domain_derivations.path_context_role: historical identity only; this geometry package is self-contained

baseline_scope: Cell-centre shape and constraints reconstructed on candidate resident coordinates/connectivity; no second model or old state read

workpiece.cell_selection: native cell centre inside closed analytic shape; only original lower-half cells
workpiece.boundary_representation: native cell staircase; analytic circle is not a fitted boundary
workpiece.initial_gap_scope: nearest original mechanism node on matching horizontal/vertical native node lines; not contact onset
workpiece.kinematics: fixed rigid constraint overlay, all incident ux/uy remain undeformed
workpiece.material_role: Original arrays unchanged; fixed cell nodes imply interior F=I and Hu=0 without material evaluation

shared_edge_connectivity.requirement: one shared-edge-connected mechanism body; separate workpieces are not part of solid

support_attachment.requirement: at least two attached distinct nodes for interface smoke only

input_attachment.requirement: all original weighted port nodes attached to solid

output_attachment.requirement: all original weighted port nodes attached to solid

min_feature.reason: No validated minimum-feature measurement in HF-1; connectivity is not manufacturing qualification

initial_gap_scope: nearest original mechanism node on matching horizontal/vertical native node lines; not contact onset
